references.text: Jesus speaks to the disciples about being salt and light, and how they must surpass the righteousness of the scribes and Pharisees, who are criticized in Matthew 23:29 for their hypocrisy.
Similar to Jesus' criticism in Matthew 23:29, where he rebukes the religious leaders for honoring the prophets with their mouths while they themselves would have killed them.
Jesus warns against scribes who seek honor but exploit widows and pray long prayers. This reveals their hypocrisy, which aligns with the criticism in Matthew 23:29.

It speaks of how the ancestors of faith suffered and died in faith without receiving what was promised, which can be seen in connection with how the Pharisees build monuments over the prophets whom their ancestors killed.
